rounds.response:
Θ(n) is the correct tight bound (not Θ(n log n)).  
Each i contributes at most floor(log2(n/i))+1 inner steps, so T = sum_{i=1}^n (1 + floor(log2(n/i))).  
Count by doubling levels: for k ≥ 0 the number of i with at least k+1 iterations is ⌊n / 2^k⌋, hence T = sum_{k≥0} ⌊n/2^k⌋ = n·sum_{k≥0}2^{-k} + O(log n) = 2n + O(log n) = Θ(n).  
Use this level-counting sentence (or the equivalent Stirling/factorial simplification) as your brief justification.
